extracted.intended_audience: FEC commissioners and staff; campaign finance policymakers; campaign finance lawyers; civil liberties advocates
extracted.subtask_description: An advocacy comment responding to an FEC Notice of Proposed Rulemaking proposing a re-definition of the term 'public communication' and two alternatives for governing disclosures and disclaimers for internet-based election communications. The document evaluates those alternatives and states the ACLU's positions on disclosure rules for online political ads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'public communication'
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether and how the term 'public communication' should be re-defined for purposes of campaign finance regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The NPRM proposes to re-define 'public communication' and offers two alternatives; the ACLU's comment analyzes both alternatives and suggests ways to build upon them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of internet communications as functionally equivalent to other media
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet communications advocating support or opposition for candidates for office should be subject to substantially the same disclosure and disclaimer requirements as are imposed on election communications in other media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ACLU expresses strong support for the notion of applying substantially the same disclosure/disclaimer regime to internet-based advocacy that applies in traditional media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of disclosure requirements for non-express-advocacy ads
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether disclosure requirements should apply to ads that do not expressly advocate for the election or defeat of a candidate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ACLU reiterates its historical opposition to disclosure requirements with respect to ads that do not expressly advocate for the election or defeat of a candidate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare and improve the two proposed alternatives for disclosures/disclaimers
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the two alternatives the NPRM offers for governing disclosures and disclaimers for internet-based election communications, and identify ways to refine or build upon them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The comments offer commentary on both alternatives and propose ways to build upon them to achieve appropriate disclosure/disclaimer rules for online contexts.
